import collections
lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
grid = [[lines[15+3*i][15+3*j] for j in range(11)] for i in range(11)]
floor=set('gWbN')
start=(0,2); goal=(10,10)
q=collections.deque([(start,[])])
seen={start}
dirs={'U':(-1,0),'D':(1,0),'L':(0,-1),'R':(0,1)}
best=None
while q:
    (i,j),p=q.popleft()
    if (i,j)==goal: best=p; break
    for d,(di,dj) in dirs.items():
        mi,mj=i+di,j+dj
        si,sj=i+2*di,j+2*dj
        if 0<=mi<11 and 0<=mj<11 and 0<=si<11 and 0<=sj<11 and (si,sj) not in seen \
           and grid[mi][mj] in floor and grid[si][sj] in floor:
            seen.add((si,sj)); q.append(((si,sj),p+[d]))
print('len', len(best) if best else None, best)
i,j=start
ok=True
for d in (best or []):
    di,dj=dirs[d]; i+=2*di; j+=2*dj
    if not (0<=i<11 and 0<=j<11 and grid[i][j] in floor): ok=False; break
print('sim ok', ok, (i,j))
if best and ok:
    names={'U':'UP','D':'DOWN','L':'LEFT','R':'RIGHT'}
    res=action([names[d] for d in best])
    print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward','error')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
